fields.label: P.E. Stamp Image
fields.description: Only placed on a packet after the engineer of record signs; the packet is otherwise watermarked PRELIMINARY.

fields.label: Text-line Item
fields.description: A non-stock Item the Fountain Designer uses for a BOM line that has no Item yet, when it pushes a Quotation or Material Request; the line's own description replaces the Item's. Blank: such lines are listed in the Quotation's terms instead, and left off a Material Request.

fields.options: Design constants no public source gives. Each ships as a placeholder cited "Sapphire standard, 2026-11-01 (placeholder until the designers set it)". When the designers have agreed the values, set the date below: the Fountain Designer then cites "Sapphire standard, <that date>". Labor hours of 0 mean not set, never free. Any other rule left at 0 (spray loss aside) uses its default.

fields.label: House rules set on
fields.description: The date the designers agreed these values. Blank keeps the placeholder citation.

fields.label: Foam-jet submergence, minimum (in)
fields.description: Shallowest water over a level-sensitive foam jet when the cut sheet gives no band. Default: 2.0. Sapphire standard, 2026-11-01 (placeholder until the designers set it)

fields.label: Foam-jet submergence, maximum (in)
fields.description: Deepest water over a level-sensitive foam jet when the cut sheet gives no band. Default: 4.0. Sapphire standard, 2026-11-01 (placeholder until the designers set it)

fields.label: Autofill deadband (in)
fields.description: How far the level drifts before the autofill opens; must sit inside the jet's band. Default: 0.5. Sapphire standard, 2026-11-01 (placeholder until the designers set it)

fields.label: Freeboard multiplier (x)
fields.description: Freeboard = this x the computed drain-back level rise. Default: 1.3. Sapphire standard, 2026-11-01 (placeholder until the designers set it); modeled on digital-rain-curtain src/hydro/presets.js autoBasin (1.3 x drain-back rise)

fields.label: Liner overlap allowance (ft)
fields.description: Liner = length + 2 x depth + this overlap (each direction). Default: 2.0. Sapphire standard, 2026-11-01 (placeholder until the designers set it)

fields.label: Lighting watts per foot of jet (W/ft)
fields.description: Lamp watts per foot of display height when no fixture is picked. Default: 5.0. Sapphire standard, 2026-11-01 (placeholder until the designers set it)

fields.label: Lighting watts per foot of weir (W/ft)
fields.description: Lamp watts per foot of weir or sheet length when no fixture is picked. Default: 4.0. Sapphire standard, 2026-11-01 (placeholder until the designers set it)

fields.label: Default fixture watts (W)
fields.description: The fixture size used to count fixtures before a model is picked. Default: 35.0. Sapphire standard, 2026-11-01 (placeholder until the designers set it)

fields.label: Wind control stage 1 (reduce) (mph)
fields.description: Anemometer speed at which jets drop to the reduced height. Default: 12.0. Sapphire standard, 2026-11-01 (placeholder until the designers set it)

fields.label: Wind control stage 2 (stop) (mph)
fields.description: Anemometer speed at which jets shut off. Default: 20.0. Sapphire standard, 2026-11-01 (placeholder until the designers set it)

fields.label: Aerator: pond length-to-width per unit (ratio)
fields.description: Above this length-to-width ratio, split the horsepower over several units. Default: 3.0. Sapphire standard, 2026-11-01 (placeholder until the designers set it)

fields.label: Spray loss, weirs and sheet falls (% of flow)
fields.description: Water lost to spray and splash beyond evaporation, as a share of flow. Default: 0.5. Sapphire standard, 2026-11-01 (placeholder until the designers set it); starting value from digital-rain-curtain src/hydro/checks.js basinChecks (spray loss 0.5% of flow)
